name: agent-x-agent
description: axa — a local-first Boss / secretary / worker collaboration hub

scripts.build: pnpm prompts:generate && pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @contagxt/axa-console build
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @contagxt/axa-proto build && pnpm --filter @contagxt/refer build && pnpm --filter @contagxt/axa-core build && pnpm --filter @contagxt/axa-secretary build && pnpm --filter @contagxt/axa-cli build
scripts.dev: pnpm prompts:generate && pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @contagxt/axa-console dev
